title: Mechanics of Endogenous Covariate Shift
summary: Work through Mechanics of Endogenous Covariate Shift.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Mechanics of Endogenous Covariate Shift** in *Physical Data* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Physical Data, § Mechanics of Endogenous Covariate Shift
blocks.md: When an image classifier misidentifies a dog as a cat, the mistake does not alter the pixels of the next photograph in the test set. When a door-opening policy misses the latch centerline by a millimeter, that motion shifts the camera viewpoint, changes the contact geometry, and alters every observation that follows. Classical empirical risk minimization assumes the first setting, drawing independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples from an exogenous, stationary distribution ExogenousDataDistribution.

questions.q: The section **Mechanics of Endogenous Covariate Shift** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Because a physical machine's own executed actions choose its next states and observations, the learner visits a distribution its demonstrations never sampled, so more nominal demonstrations only densify the region the expert already covered.
Physical data is bought in cell time and component life, so less than a quarter of a scheduled hour survives as retained demonstration and failed attempts wear parts like successful ones.
Behavioral cloning fits actions to observations under the expert's occupancy, so a low held-out loss says nothing about closed-loop competence.
A scenario table enumerates the cells the declared domain requires over low-dimensional task invariants, because a brute-force state grid is defeated by dimensionality.
